environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed in namespace 'infra-tools' on an Istio-enabled GKE cluster (v1.19). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a DENY action for requests where source.namespace is NOT in the set ['monitoring-system']. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with ALLOW action requires the request principal to match 'cluster.local/ns/monitoring-system/sa/prometheus-diagnostics'. The Istio sidecar (envoy) is injected via namespace label istio-injection=enabled. PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mTLS for the namespace. Note: the AuthorizationPolicy evaluation order means DENY policies are evaluated before ALLOW policies per Istio's authorization engine semantics.
